runs:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p _site/assets
cp -r site/. _site/
# Reuse the already-shipped demo assets; never rebuild them here.
for f in demo.gif logo-light.svg logo-dark.svg logo-mark.png social-preview.png \
hero-banner-dark.svg hero-banner-light.svg \
hero-diagram.svg editors-strip.svg; do
[ -f ".github/assets/$f" ] && cp ".github/assets/$f" "_site/assets/$f" || true
done

sync.name: Sync marketplace version pins
runs:
{
echo '### sync-plugins'
echo ''
echo '```'
cat /tmp/sync.txt 2>/dev/null || echo '(no output)'
echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

set -euo pipefail
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
echo "No changes to commit."
exit 0
fi
# One commit for the whole run: "chore(sync): a 1.0.0 → 1.1.0, b 2.0.0 → 2.1.0"
bumps=$(awk '/^bump: /{ printf "%s%s %s \342\206\222 %s", (n++ ? ", " : ""), $2, $3, $5 }' /tmp/sync.txt)
if [ -z "$bumps" ]; then
bumps="marketplace version pins"
fi
git commit -m "chore(sync): $bumps"
git push

validate.name: Validate marketplace
runs:
if command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then
echo "claude CLI found, validating marketplace manifest (strict)"
claude plugin validate . --strict
else
echo "SKIP: 'claude' CLI is not installed on this runner; skipping plugin validate."
echo "JSON validity is already enforced by the previous step."
fi

set -euo pipefail
asset="gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
url="https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/${asset}"
echo "Downloading $url"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/gitleaks.tar.gz "$url"
tar -xzf /tmp/gitleaks.tar.gz -C /tmp gitleaks
chmod +x /tmp/gitleaks
/tmp/gitleaks version
/tmp/gitleaks dir . --no-banner --redact --exit-code 1
